title: I WILL NEVER LEAVE YOU: Feature Film
description:
I WILL NEVER LEAVE YOU follows a highly successful entrepreneur as he struggles with

his mental health, crippling addictions and abject loneliness. Plagued by recurring


nightmares and fragmented memories, a chance encounter leads him on a journey of self-

discovery as he delves deeper into the dark and disturbing truths of his family history. As his world begins to crumble, he is left with only one choice - he must confront his

troubled past if he’s ever to secure a meaningful future.


Available Materials: Pitch Deck / Treatment.
